prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Na Ruixa, the golden-haired Mallorcan water fairy who enchants sailors and catches them with her wide blue cloak in storms.
ANATOMY: ONE beautiful ADULT fairy woman, one head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs fully covered by opaque high-neck dark BLUE GOWN and an ENORMOUS WIDE BLUE CLOAK. Long BLOND HAIR like threads of GOLD, no wings, crown, scales, fish tail or horns [na-ruixa-c04,na-ruixa-c06].
MOMENT: Emerge forcefully from a coastal cave and spread BOTH ARMS to unfurl the immense blue cloak toward viewer like a sweeping enclosing sail, mouth open mid-enchanting song, eyes severe and intent downward. Cloak billows around square edges in the violent gale but remains one continuous cloth attached at shoulders. Her blue cloak whips around one anonymous ADULT sailor who is RIGHT NEXT TO HER at the SAME DEPTH, with his head almost as large as hers and shoulders as broad as hers. Both adults stand on the SAME small grounded fishing boat near a cave. Her cloak encloses his fully clothed torso like a cloth trap, without injury, drowning or physical assault. The sailor is secondary but plainly normal human size relative to her.
POWER: wide cloak catches unwary sailors in storms, melodious voice enchants them; depict the enclosing cloak reaching the boat and real gale-driven cloth/spray, no floating musical symbols, voice ribbons or beams [na-ruixa-c04,na-ruixa-c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: tight low waist-up view from the SAME small boat: normal-size fairy at left and NORMAL-SIZE ADULT sailor beside her at right, EQUAL BODY SCALE AND EQUAL HEAD SIZE, both in same plane. Fairy and trapping cloak dominate the square; sailor face turned away. The boat is a normal fishing boat, not a miniature. NOT a giantess, no forced perspective, no little people.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm sunset opening through storm clouds illuminates golden hair and wet blue folds, deep walnut cave shadows, rough sea spray and heavy ordinary rain.
SURFACE: heavy saturated BLUE woven cloak, opaque gown, wet golden hair, slick black coastal rock.
SETTING: sea cave on Mallorca, storm-lashed bay possibly Pollença, background secondary [na-ruixa-c04].
MOOD: dangerous beautiful uncanny water-fairy authority, intense active confrontation, never erotic model, ordinary woman in cape, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
